title: The Ultimate Origins SMP
description: The official whitelist only server for the 1.20.1 version of the Ultimate Origins Modpack. Come join the final season of a server that has been running since June of 2021.
body:
Welcome to The Ultimate Origins SMP. This is the official whitelist only server for the 1.20.1 version of the Ultimate Origins Modpack.

We are currently in our 6th season, and it will be our final one. This season has been running since April 28 2023, and we have built an incredible community along the way. With over 540 whitelisted players, there is always someone to adventure with.

Here is what you can expect when you join us:

- A player driven world. Spawn, the shopping district, community farms, and more are all built entirely by the players.
- The full Ultimate Origins Modpack experience. Explore the world with over 200 mods including Origins, Terralith, Create, and many more.
- Custom origins made specifically for our server.
- A deep server lore that you are free to add to and explore.
- A friendly and welcoming community that has been playing together for years.
- Land claiming with Flan to keep your builds safe.
- A completely free to play experience with no pay to win.

If you are looking for a long term home with a great group of people, this is the place for you.


**Important Links**


[Ultimate Origins Modpack](https://modrinth.com/modpack/ultimate-origins-modpack)

[Apply on Discord](https://discord.gg/kPfPKWCVUF)
